requirements: R1: The backup service must start without crashing due to file-bind-mount directory errors.
R2: The docker-compose deployment configuration must mount the parent scripts directory to ensure files are accessed correctly without Docker auto-creating them as directories.

slices.title: Fix backup service script bind mount in docker-compose
slices.jtbd: When implementing the environment fix for this epic, I want the backup service to mount its scripts directory correctly, so that the service initializes and the environment achieves a healthy state.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a docker-compose deployment environment,
When the backup service starts,
Then its volume configuration must map the parent directory (e.g. `./scripts:/scripts:ro`) rather than a discrete file.
Given the container has started,
When the script executes,
Then it must not fail with an 'Is a directory' error.
